answer: In an agent market, zephyr, timber, and fable can each create many accounts, but voting power is proportional to tokens locked in a governance contract, with a 30-day withdrawal delay. Splitting 100 tokens among 1,000 identities yields the same total voting weight as staking them in one account. A sybil attacker must therefore acquire and immobilize additional capital to gain influence; generating more names buys no extra votes.
